newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industry sales down 2.49 pct in August - CNI.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industry sales down 2.49 pct in August - CNI.

text.p: Brazilian industry sales were down a seasonally adjusted 2.49 percent in August compared with July, the private National Industry Confederation (CNI) said.
Sales in real terms were 0.42 percent higher in August than in July, the CNI said in a statement.
August's sales were 8.82 percent higher than in the same month last year, it said.
Industry sales for the year to August showed growth of 2.38 percent over the same period last year, the CNI said.
Industry functioned at a seasonally-adjusted average of 78.1 percent of capacity in August, down from 78.9 percent in July but up from 77.1 percent in August 1995, it said.
The number of workers employed, hours worked and salaries paid remained virtually unchanged in August compared with July.
"The retraction observed (in sales) follows a significant expansion during the previous month, confirming a fluctuating pattern for sales recovery," the statement said.
